name: CrossNext for Sticky
summary: An EPUB reader with Vietnamese, English and Spanish menus, study tools, games, and saved book highlights on the sleep screen.
description: CrossNext for Sticky adapts CrossNext to reTerminal Sticky with EPUB, TXT, Markdown and XTC/XTCH reading, flashcards, vocabulary tools, a virtual pet and games. Version 1.4.8 adds saved book highlights on the sleep screen with optional timed rotation. A microSD card holds books and application data. Basic reading works offline; optional online integrations require Wi-Fi and their respective services.

compatibility.notes: Targets reTerminal Sticky (ESP32-S3, SSD1677 display, GT911 touch). Insert a FAT32 microSD card for books and application data. The maintainer reports v1.4.8 working on real hardware: reading, touch/buttons, reboot with reading position preserved, and USB reconnection. Timed highlight wake and sleep current remain unverified.

assets.previewAlt: CrossNext for Sticky on a physical reTerminal Sticky, showing the reading shelf and app navigation

notes.title: USB installation
notes.description: Connect Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge. The complete factory image is installed at offset 0x0. Back up device settings and microSD data before replacing firmware.

notes.title: First boot and storage
notes.description: Insert a FAT32 microSD card containing your books. If Sticky stays in USB charging standby after reset, hold the physical Power button to wake the interface.

notes.title: Book highlight sleep screen
notes.description: Settings > Display > Sleep screen > Book highlights uses saved passages from /My Clippings.txt. Set Change highlight every to 0 to disable timed rotation. Timer wake behavior and sleep current still require physical-device verification.
